stage_note: Design: Read-LogTail (last 64 KB, shared read while cloudflared writes, partial first line dropped) + Get-TunnelNetworkVerdict (plain Contains: 'Registered tunnel connection' -> connected; >= 6 lines with 'dial tcp' and '7844: i/o timeout' -> port-blocked; else unknown). Start-Component also records the Err log (ErrLog); an adopted tunnel uses the newest tunnel*.err.log. Invoke-Tunnel: /ready 200 clears blocked; otherwise port-blocked -> state 'blocked', detail 'network blocks tunnel port 7844 (outbound TCP); not restarting', no restart; after 30 min blocked (TunnelBlockedRetryMinutes) one fresh launch, then 30 min again. status.json link.blocked_reason/blocked_since/blocked_retry_at; link.html shows the reason under the link.
